about: Overcooked!, Overcooked! 2 and all additional content are blended together and remastered in this delicious definitive edition!
Enjoy hundreds of levels of cooperative cooking chaos across increasingly perilous and obscure kitchens.
Overcooked! Goes Online For the first time ever, online multiplayer has been fully integrated into Overcooked! Revisit your favourite kitchens from the first game in stunning 4K and ONLINE!
Both games have been taken to the next level with stunning, enhanced 4K visuals - this is the best that the Overcooked! series has ever looked.
summary: Journey back to the Onion Kingdom for a feast of epic proportions!
